claims.evidence: Paper: blood from vena caudalis centrifuged to plasma; PRIDE organism part Blood plasma
Paper/PRIDE: proteomics on plasma at end of first feeding period (30 days)
PRIDE protocol: Ultimate 3000 RSLCnano with Q Exactive
Paper: 10 ug trypsin overnight; Scaffold file enzyme Trypsin

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M variable; Acetyl N-term variable
claims.evidence: Decoded from Scaffold Experiment object in deposited 171030_LagosLeidy.sf3 (Mascot 2.4.0 results, Scaffold 4.4.8)

limitations: Mapping of the 16 files (CJK_..._01-16) to the four diets (FM, SBM, SBM200CU, FM200CU; PRIDE D1, D2, D6, D7) is not in the deposit: Scaffold sample names are just file names; treatment therefore not available and no factor value is declared.
Biological replicate numbers 1-16 are one per file only because the within-diet replicate assignment is unknown.
Deposited files are .mgf peak lists although PRIDE categorises them as RAW; no RAW headers could be read.

Strain, sex, developmental stage not stated (fish were vaccinated post-smolts, 526 g average initial weight) - not available; disease (SBM-induced enteritis in some groups) not assigned because groups cannot be mapped.

Precursor/fragment tolerances not recoverable for the deposited Mascot search (paper values 6/20 ppm refer to a later MaxQuant reanalysis) - not available. Reduction/alkylation not stated in the text although carbamidomethyl was searched as fixed.
Acetyl was set to PP=Any N-term from Scaffold residue code n; Protein N-term not verified. NCE 28 taken from PRIDE protocol; MS2 analyzer not stated.
